text:
Asha (CSM): Heads up — SparrowTech renewal flagged. Noticed a ~65% drop in API calls since Monday (same seat count). Procurement looped in a new legal lead at Sparrow (Tom) and asked for a competitor feature comparison. Link to activity: https://redwood.app/dash/sparrowtech-usage :eyes:

Riley (Account MG): Ugh ok. Any sign it's environment issues vs product fit?

Asha (CSM): No platform incidents. I checked traces and p95 latency is normal. The drop looks like fewer automated scoring jobs (batch calls) — looks like they toggled a pipeline. They mentioned cost concerns in last call.

Nina (SalesEng): Can you share the top 3 endpoints by token usage and whether they switched to a cheaper model? Also, do we have their billing trend?

Asha (CSM): Top endpoints: /v1/generate (55%), /v1/embeddings (30%), /v1/rerank (15%). Billing shows a 48% cost reduction MoM starting this week. No model switch recorded in our logs. Possible they throttled at client side.

Michael (CS Ops): Quick triage playbook suggestion: 1) Confirm with Tom whether they intentionally paused pipelines. 2) Offer a short term cost-smoothing plan (2 weeks discounted burst). 3) Prep a one-pager comparison for the competitor ask (feature + latency + price). I can draft the one-pager.

Riley (Account MG): I'll take the outreach to Tom. Asha, can you capture exact example timestamps & a minimal repro snippet I can include?

Asha (CSM): On it. Minimal repro snippet (example client throttle):
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "redwood-2-medium", "max_tokens": 256, "prompt": "..." }
// client returns 429 every 10th call, then stops batching
```
Will paste full query ranges in a sec.

OpsBot: Activity report generated — https://redwood.app/reports/sparrowtech/2409876543 (contains per-endpoint p50/p95, billing delta, recent deploys).

Nina (SalesEng): Good. While Riley reaches out, I'll assemble the competitor comparison and highlight our prefix-caching + dedicated throughput advantages. Also suggest we propose a cost experiment: move their rerank jobs to a quantized variant for 1 week.

Michael (CS Ops): If they accept the cost experiment, I can provision a temporary dedicated pool and set an autoscale cap. We'll track tokens/sec and rollback if quality regresses.

Riley (Account MG): Plan: I’ll email Tom today with: short summary + ask whether pause was intentional + offer call + we’ll propose the cost-experiment + attach the one-pager if they ask. Assigning internal owners: Asha — logs & repro; Nina — competitor deck + quant suggestion; Michael — temporary pool ops plan.

Asha (CSM): Assigned. ETA for attachments: Asha (logs) by EOD, Nina (deck) 24h, Michael (ops runbook) by EOD tomorrow.

Nina (SalesEng)::+1: Will also schedule a 30m call slot for early next week.

Riley (Account MG): Thanks team. If Tom signals procurement/legal friction, escalate to sales leadership. Will update thread after outreach.

Asha (CSM): Quick note for renewal scoring: mark as "at-risk - usage drop + competitive interest" for now. Update renewal playbook record with next steps.

Michael (CS Ops): Adding monitoring alert for any further sudden drops and a dashboard card for the proposed dedicated pool metrics.

Asha (CSM): Closing loop here for now — will post Tom's reply and next steps. :wave:
